title: RLC 串联的阶跃响应（零状态）
statement: 图示 RLC 串联电路原来不带电（零状态），电压源为 10ε(t) V；R = 6 Ω，L = 1 H，C = 40 mF。
求 u_L(0₊)、α 和 ω_d，t = π/8 s 时的电流 i，以及 t = π/4 s 时的 u_C。

questions.explain: 零状态：u_C(0₊) = 0，i(0₊) = 0，R 上无压降，电源电压全部加在电感上：u_L(0₊) = 10 V（di/dt(0₊) = 10 A/s）。
i = C·du_C/dt = U_s/(ω_d L)·e^(−αt) sin ω_d t = 2.5e^(−3t) sin 4t A。t = π/8：sin(π/2) = 1，i = 2.5e^(−3π/8) ≈ 0.7697 A。
u_C = 10 − 10e^(−3t)(cos 4t + 0.75 sin 4t) V。t = π/4：cos π = −1，sin π = 0，u_C = 10 + 10e^(−3π/4) ≈ 10.948 V——超过终值 10 V（超调），也是 u_C 的最大值，因为此时 i = 0。

hints: 判断阻尼：2√(L/C) = 10 Ω > R，欠阻尼；u_C = 10 + e^(−αt)(A₁cos ω_d t + A₂sin ω_d t)。

en.title: Step response of a series RLC circuit (zero state)
statement: The series RLC circuit is initially uncharged (zero state) and driven by 10ε(t) V; R = 6 Ω, L = 1 H, C = 40 mF.
Find u_L(0+), α and ω_d, the current i at t = π/8 s, and u_C at t = π/4 s.

questions.explain: Zero state: u_C(0+) = 0 and i(0+) = 0, so there is no drop across R and the whole source voltage is across the inductor: u_L(0+) = 10 V (di/dt(0+) = 10 A/s).
i = C·du_C/dt = U_s/(ω_d L)·e^(−αt) sin ω_d t = 2.5e^(−3t) sin 4t A. At t = π/8, sin(π/2) = 1, so i = 2.5e^(−3π/8) ≈ 0.7697 A.

u_C = 10 − 10e^(−3t)(cos 4t + 0.75 sin 4t) V. At t = π/4, cos π = −1 and sin π = 0: u_C = 10 + 10e^(−3π/4) ≈ 10.948 V — above the final value of 10 V (overshoot). It is also the maximum of u_C, because i = 0 there.

hints: Zero state: u_C(0+) = 0, i(0+) = 0. Final value u_C(∞) = 10 V (C open).
Damping: 2√(L/C) = 10 Ω > R, so it is underdamped; u_C = 10 + e^(−αt)(A₁cos ω_d t + A₂sin ω_d t).
Fix the constants with u_C(0+) = 0 and du_C/dt(0+) = i(0+)/C = 0.
solution: **1. Initial and final values.** u_C(0+) = 0, i(0+) = 0 → **u_L(0+) = 10 V**; u_C(∞) = 10 V.
**2. Roots.** s² + (R/L)s + 1/(LC) = s² + 6s + 25 = 0 → s = −3 ± j4, i.e. **α = 3 s⁻¹, ω_d = 4 rad/s** (2√(L/C) = 10 Ω > 6 Ω, underdamped).

**3. Complete solution = particular + homogeneous.** u_C = 10 + e^(−3t)(A₁cos 4t + A₂sin 4t). u_C(0+) = 0 → A₁ = −10; du_C/dt(0+) = 0 → −3A₁ + 4A₂ = 0 → A₂ = −7.5. u_C = 10 − 10e^(−3t)(cos 4t + 0.75 sin 4t) V.
**5. Overshoot.** At t = π/ω_d = π/4 s, i = 0 and u_C peaks: **u_C = 10 + 10e^(−3π/4) ≈ 10.948 V**, an overshoot of about 9.5 %.
